scope: Measured trace replay with BookSim's native 32nm power/area model. Network only; no compute, DRAM, NIC or silicon calibration. One run per workload; arms within a workload share one trace, binary and seed, but are not resource-equalised.

model.technology: 2007 ITRS 32nm high-performance prediction; not silicon calibrated
model.energy_definition: native total W / model clock Hz * OCN Completion Time * 1e12; network pJ over the full power-counter interval, not packet-arrival cycles
model.limitations: Architectural data-path model, not silicon calibrated. No NIC/compute/DRAM, credit/control-wire costs or allocator/layout signoff. Ordinary wire length uses latency * tech wire_length; shared grid trunks use tech wire_length as router pitch with always-propagating full-swing data and one D2 isolation input per bit/tap. Repeaters/retiming are costed, not proof that simulated latency is physically feasible. Power counters span the full simulation.
